summary: T10 fully implements the saved plan. smoke.py removes the mocked_local fail->warn downgrade so local Core health is a hard signal (SMOKE_SERVICE_UNREACHABLE on unreachable/unhealthy Core even in mocked mode); interprets richer collector api/worker sub-signals with enriched evidence; adds SMOKE_WORKER_UNAVAILABLE when API is up but the worker DB substrate is down; and _default_service_collector probes /healthz plus /readyz (reading checks.db.ok regardless of 503 status, degrading gracefully via _probe_worker_substrate). start_commands._start_success_payload leads next_steps with the provider-free `awf smoke run --mocked-local` proof; profile_smoke_commands help text describes the no-token local proof. All 8 planned tests are present (regression flip warn->fail, mocked-local success with api/worker evidence, worker-substrate-down fail, four collector probe cases, backward-compat plain-ok, first-run leading-step assertions, provider-free help, setup chain). Console false-green coverage (test_console_unavailable_reports_reason_code, test_configured_console_url_reports_unavailable_when_probe_fails) is preserved unchanged in test_smoke_part_001.py. Non-goals (E2E lanes, provider setup, full docs) respected. Validation document records focused ruff/ruff-format/mypy/pytest evidence, all green.
